completions.athlete_note: Easy miles turned progression run lol, with Hope.

High humidity and dew point. Breathing controlled, hardest part muscular. Felt fluid, legs strong, finished strong and felt another two miles was there. Increased calories and carbs and felt stronger. Huge confidence booster.
Supposed to be easy miles. Plan was to get base points but that just didn't seem possible with weather.

Four straight intervals, consistent times, did not stop until cool down. Stopped at 4 and shortened cool down: stomach cramping badly, sharp chest pains from heat and cramps. Could maybe have got 6 but it would have been max effort. Rep 4 was a 9 out of 10, floats started to fade so it made sense to stop at 4. Legs felt tired once into the first interval but speed felt locked in.
